## 🔁 Follow-up Autopilot (Pro)
Runs every morning at 9:00 (your n8n timezone). For every lead in your sheet that has an email address it:
- checks **Gmail Sent** to see if you actually sent the pitch,
- checks your **inbox for replies** → marks the lead **Replied** and never emails them again,
- drafts a short follow-up **in the same thread** after 3 days, and a last polite one after 7 more days.

Drafts only: you review and send. Change the timing in **⚙️ Settings** (followUpDays, maxFollowUps).

**Setup:** reuse the same Google Sheets, Gmail and Anthropic credentials as Client Finder, paste your sheet URL in Settings, then activate/publish.
